analogue: Gas-phase accretion of two C₁₀H₁₅O₁₀ peroxy radicals from α-pinene ozonolysis to form C₂₀H₃₀O₁₈.
citation: Large Gas-Phase Source of Esters and Other Accretion Products in the Atmosphere
evidence: Gas-phase mass spectrometry with isotope substitutions supported accretion from α-pinene peroxy radicals, including a 20-carbon product retaining the expected exchangeable hydrogens.
difference: The chemical identity and concentration of G_A are unresolved in the fit. A gas-phase accretion product need not immediately or entirely reach suspended particles.
